lines.zh: 我扇着大翅膀穿过林间
lines.en: I beat my wide wings through the trees
Blue shimmers across my wings
I fly along the band of light in the forest

lines.zh: 我贴着林下的光带慢慢扇翅
lines.en: I flap slowly along the band of light beneath the canopy.
I settle on a pink tulip

lines.zh: 我从花上飞起来又落下
lines.en: I lift off the flower and settle again
My wingtips graze the vines
I circle a tree low down
I fly lighter than the wind

lines.zh: 热带的光照在我的翅膀上
lines.en: The tropical light falls on my wings
I weave between flower and flower

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一高一低地扇
lines.en: My wings beat high and low
I fly beneath the canopy

lines.zh: 我顺着林中的风往上飘
lines.en: I ride the forest wind upward
I look for gaps among the vines
My shadow lands on the leaf
I rest motionless on a flower
My wings slowly close
I stay in the flower's heart
My antennae turn slightly
I am sunning on the flower

lines.zh: 我的翅膀上有细密的纹
lines.en: Fine lines run across my wings

lines.zh: 我停在郁金香上，翅慢慢合起来
lines.en: I rest on a tulip, wings folding slowly.
I hide myself in the leaf shadow
I taste the flower's heart

lines.zh: 我停在花心，等光转个方向
lines.en: I sit in the flower's heart and wait for the light to turn.

lines.zh: 我合着翅膀站在花瓣上
lines.en: I stand on a petal with wings closed

lines.zh: 我在花上轻轻换了换脚
lines.en: I shift my feet lightly on the flower
You are hiding my flower

lines.zh: 我翅膀的颜色比你的衣服亮
lines.en: My wing color is brighter than your clothes
You have stood by the flower a long time
I raise my antennae toward you

lines.zh: 你低头找了我很久，我才动一下
lines.en: You searched for me a long while before I moved.
Do not come at me with a net
I am taking nectar here
My feet cannot reach your face

lines.zh: 这片丛林你走得太快了
lines.en: You walk this jungle too fast
Step back a little or I will fly
My wing is pinned

lines.zh: 翅膀被压皱了，我只能爬
lines.en: My wing is crumpled; I can only crawl.
Much of my wing dust has come off
I flutter on the ground

lines.zh: 这一下伤到了我的翅脉
lines.en: That hurt my wing veins
I try two beats

lines.zh: 翅膀缺了一角，我飞得歪歪斜斜
lines.en: A corner of my wing is gone and I fly crooked.
My body is numb from the blow
I land on a flower to recover
I want to fly once more
Is that flower yours
Pink flowers are my favorite
I flew a little closer

lines.zh: 你把花举起来，我就能落
lines.en: Raise the flower and I can land
This pink is exactly right

lines.zh: 我这么大一只，落在上面很沉
lines.en: A butterfly this big lands heavily

lines.zh: 我绕着这朵粉花飞了半圈
lines.en: I fly half a circle around this pink bloom.
I smell the nectar
My wings have slowed
Let me settle on the flower

lines.zh: 你的指尖擦过我的翅缘，粉掉了一点
lines.en: Your fingertip grazes my wing edge and a little dust rubs off.
My flight tilted
I rose a little at once
Some of my wing dust came off
I retreat behind the flower

lines.zh: 这一下让我差点掉下去
lines.en: That nearly dropped me
My wings are still trembling
You have blue on your finger

lines.zh: 我们撞得很轻，但我很小
lines.en: We barely touched, but I am small
I find my balance again

lines.zh: 两只闪蝶在粉花上方对着飞
lines.en: Two morphos fly facing each other above the pink flowers.
Your wings are smaller than mine
Two morphos beat their wings together
I settle beside you
Our blue looks better together
We do not speak, only beat our wings
This forest is enough for us to fly
Your antenna touched mine
We rise together

lines.zh: 我们不用说话，翅一开一合就行
lines.en: We need no words; a wing opening and closing is enough.
I land beside it and look
This is not a flower

lines.zh: 我先用触角试了试，才落下
lines.en: I test it with my antennae before settling.
It does not taste sweet

lines.zh: 我用前足拨了拨，又飞到花上
lines.en: I probe it with a foreleg and fly back to the flower.

lines.zh: 这东西有点甜味，我舔了一口
lines.en: It tastes a little sweet; I take one sip.

lines.zh: 我落下去又起来，试了两次
lines.en: I land, lift off, and try it twice.
This will not block me
I stand on it, a little slippery
I finally fly away
That flower moves in the wind
I see a brighter patch
I adjust my flight direction
The wind blew it toward me
I can make it in one flight
My wings are already open
I have fixed on that color
There is nectar that way
I rise slowly a little
I am flying over now
I keep flying that way
I go around a leaf
The wind pushed me a little off course
I adjust the angle of my wings
The flower is still there

lines.zh: 我的颜色在树影里不显眼
lines.en: My color is not obvious in the tree shadow
One short flight more
I landed once and rose again
The light direction has changed
I am nearly at it
I strike with my wings

lines.zh: 我拿翅膀拍你，像拍一片叶
lines.en: I slap you with my wing the way I'd slap a leaf.
I bump with my body
It swayed from my bump
Some powder scattered from my wings
I fly off at once
I did not want a fight
I only want that flower

lines.zh: 我翅上的粉扑了它一下
lines.en: I puff my wing powder at it
I bump and rise high at once
I fly down from the tree

lines.zh: 丛林的光正好穿过叶子
lines.en: The jungle light comes through the leaves just right
My wings open for the first time
Blue wavers in the air
I settle on the nearest flower
There are many flowers in this forest
Daylight is when I move

lines.zh: 我从丛林高处滑下来，蓝色一闪
lines.en: I glide down from the jungle canopy, a flash of blue.
I look like a moving leaf
I rise from under the leaf into the light

lines.zh: 火把我的翅膀卷了起来
lines.en: Fire curled my wings
I fell out of the air

lines.zh: 水把我的翅膀贴在身上
lines.en: Water pressed my wings to my body
The blast flipped my wings over
Something passed through my wing

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的翅膀发僵
lines.en: That magic stiffened my wings
I have not found nectar yet
The flash turned the whole jungle white

lines.zh: 下面没有叶子也没有花
lines.en: There are no leaves and no flowers below
